spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap
spot_price_manipulated.checkpoint: before validatePrice and subsequent swap/liquidity action

guard_rejects_manipulated_price.meaning: the TWAP slippage guard rejects the transiently manipulated spot price as outside slippage limits

reserve_drain_occurs.meaning: liquidity manager operations or buybacks drain protocol-owned reserves

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked to check the price for a subsequent swap or liquidity action before that action executes.
The manipulated spot price is the input the guard evaluates during the same transaction.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call validatePrice or whether the attacker is permissionless, so the applicability scope of the guard cannot be narrowed beyond the transient-manipulation scenario.
No concrete amounts, percentages, or numeric loss figures are given for the reserve drain; the impact is represented as a Boolean occurrence only.

limitations: The reserve-drain impact is conditional (can/may) in the report; the plan encodes it as an observable occurrence symbol rather than an observed event.
No numeric slippage-limit or TWAP-window values are supplied, so the guard outcome is a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.
